_comment: Hand-authored tuning for the autonomous loop (master plan Phase 5). Tuned so that, measured over hours of simulated play, a workout lasts about 21 s, a meal about 18 s and a night's sleep about 19 s (twice, three times and five times the first tuning). Energy and satiety are hidden drivers on a 0-100 scale; the player never manages them and they never cause failure. Rates are per second at time scale 1. Durations are seconds.

thresholds._comment: hungry starts the eating detour and full ends it. tired ends a workout early; sleepy (checked when the cycle is free to choose) sends him to bed, so he sleeps roughly every second session; rested wakes him.

states._comment: Which animation group each behaviour state plays.
